english.title: Incur election expenses without authorisation a view to promoting or procuring the election of a candidate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of a corrupt practice in that you

(A)_[incurred]_
(B)_[aided, abetted, counselled or procured another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to incur]_

expenses with a view to promoting or procuring the election of a

(C)_[candidate,]_
(D)_[registered political party or candidates of that party),]_

namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE OR PARTY..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), after becoming a candidate at that election, when you were not the candidate,

(E)_[his]_
(F)_[her]_

election agent or a person authorised in writing by the election agent in accordance with section 75(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 75(1) and (5)(a) and section 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
being a person other than the candidate, his or her election agent or a person authorised in writing by the election agent
incurs expenses with a view to promoting or procuring the election of
a candidate (or, in the case of the election of the London members of the London Assembly at an ordinary election, a registered political party or candidates of that party) after he or she becomes a candidate at that election
on account of holding public meetings or organising a public display
OR of issuing advertisements, circulars or publications
OR of otherwise presenting to the electors the candidate or his views or the extent or nature of his backing or disparaging another candidate
OR in the case of an election of the London members of the London Assembly at an ordinary election, of otherwise presenting to the electors the candidate's registered political party, or the views of that party or the extent or nature of that party's backing or disparaging any other registered political party

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
